profiles.title: USB Type-C receptacle 16P, SMD (LCSC C165948), measured on the live editor
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-23 (16:06:43 +08:00) on the live editor: C165948 TYPE-C-31-M-12 placed at (430, 180) rotation 0 on probe page a49f56119597d6d5 (P2) of /test; sch.component_pins answered all 16 pins and its own geometry gave the body box [-25.5, -65.5, 25.5, 65.5] in symbol-local coordinates (tip = component_pins.X/Y minus the component origin; host canvas y is UP). pinType is null by design: sch.component_pins returns only X/Y/PinNumber/PinName/Rotation/PinLength/PrimitiveId/NoConnected and lib.device.get returns no pin table either, so this editor has no electrical-type read channel and any pinType written here would be invented. Direction is the compass derived from the measured Rotation (0 = right, 180 = left); only 0 and 180 occur in these eight symbols, so the 90/270 spellings are not measured and are not cited. Evidence: evidence/534/probes/pins_C165948.json + measure_summary.json text rows measured 2026-10-27, read out of the ATTR records of the page document the host itself exported on 2026-10-23 (E:/boardwise/evidence/534/discard/document_source.json, chars=189792, truncated=false) — NOT a fresh measurement of this editor today. The old page carries USB1 at origin (330,-690) rotation 0, isMirror false (the pose this candidate draws USB1), with its Designator at (305,-755) and its Name at (305,-615): offsets [-25, 65] / [-25, -75] in symbol-local units, y up. `valueRow` is the string the host actually draws in the value row (TYPE-C-31-M-12: the device Name the host resolved, not the spec's value). A pose not stated here has no measured row and keeps the compiler's own side ladder.

profiles.title: CH340G USB-serial bridge, SOP-16 (LCSC C14267, measured on the live editor)
profiles.source: measured 2026-10-03: C14267 placed at (300,500) on test/P24 (probe page fa96410e884cc55f); sch.component_pins answered all 16 pins at x=260 (pins 1-8) and x=340 (pins 9-16), y from 535 down to 465 in steps of 10, every PinLength 10; its own bbox was [269.5,454.5,330.5,545.5] -> body (-30.5,-45.5,30.5,45.5). Pin names are the host's own: GND/TXD/RXD/V3/UD+/UD-/XI/XO on the left face, CTS#/DSR#/RI#/DCD#/DTR#/RTS#/R232/VCC on the right face — both the UART pair and the USB data pair are on the LEFT, unlike 098's hand-written sample (a fact of this symbol; the presentation declares the sides it draws). Evidence: outputs/099/libprobe/pins_ch340g.json + 08_geometry_probe.json

profiles.title: PWR-GND
profiles.source: Ground flag glyph, measured on 534 r1 off the landed render (`actual.svg`, sha256 743de22379a24dde247a0673eca143f3d3b43cbbd33f92d48c2ea93b5458adfb): a 10-unit lead then 20-wide bars, i.e. `(-10, 0, 10, 19)` with the family's 180 rotation putting them below the connection point. 4/4 GND flags predicted exactly (delta [0,0,0,0]); the family still prints **no** name (4/4 have no text node — confirmed again on this page). Evidence: `.tmp_534/text-profile-measurement-r1/findings.md` sec.1.2/1.3. Supersedes the carry-over `(-6, 0, 6, 18)`; the 2026-10-03 probe's reading (connection point at the origin, PinLength 10, bars 9.5..19.5 below) is unchanged, only the extent is now measured.
